Eyewitness account revealed that Bright visited Mmesoma who was working and living in the said hotel premises.
“The deceased was said to have introduced him to the gateman. The gateman allowed Emmanuel to follow Mmesoma to her room not knowing that Emmanuel had a sinister motive.
“Few hours later, Emmanuel sneaked out of the hotel room, from the same gate he came in from. It was discovered that Emmanuel suffocated
Mmesoma, stabbed her in the stomach, took her phone and disappeared into thin air and is now at large,” the witness narrated.
When contacted, the Police Public Relations Officer (PPRO), Henry Okoye confirmed the incident.
He stressed that the Imo state Police Command has put machinery in place to apprehend the suspect.
